reason: A browser compatibility utility that prevents DeepSeek Harness attachment failures on plain-HTTP LAN access by providing a randomUUID polyfill and exposing related status in Settings.

summaries.zh: 为通过局域网纯 HTTP 访问 DeepSeek Harness 的场景提供 crypto.randomUUID 兼容补丁，并在设置页显示相关状态。
summaries.en: Provides a crypto.randomUUID compatibility fix for DeepSeek Harness accessed over plain HTTP on a LAN and displays the related status in Settings.

capabilities: Injects a crypto.randomUUID UUID v4 polyfill into the client bundle
Adds a Settings panel showing secure-context status and randomUUID source
